svg.title: One edit, two obligations
svg.desc: Exact linear illustration with fixed features and no bias change. In weight-update coordinates, the target condition is delta w1 plus delta w2 equals 1. The protection condition is delta w1 equals 0. The target-only edit is (0.5, 0.5); the intersection (0, 1) meets both conditions. The starting point is no edit (0, 0). Both axes use the same scale.
svg.title: One edit, two obligations

cc:Work.dc:title: One edit, two obligations
cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative exact-arithmetic model; not experimental evidence.
